## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed (e.g.
`Fixes #123`).

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing behavior to change)
- [ ] Documentation / repo hygiene

## How has this been tested?

Describe how you verified this change. Include device/emulator info if
applicable.

- [ ] `./gradlew assembleDebug` builds successfully
- [ ] `./gradlew lintDebug` passes with no new warnings
- [ ] Manual testing on device / emulator

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] I have added/updated documentation where needed
- [ ] New files carry the Apache 2.0 license header
- [ ] I have not committed keystores, `local.properties`, or build outputs
